What this package holds, serves and is missing, by family and year

Source: R/data_registry.R
get_data_registry.Rd

Computed offline at call time from the package's own coverage table, its source-contract manifests and its two known-fact files. There is no stored copy to fall out of date. Status `not_searched` means nobody has looked: read it as unknown, never as absent.

Usage

get_data_registry(family = NULL, end_year = NULL)

Arguments

family

Optional family to keep, such as `"enrollment"`.

end_year

Optional years to keep.

Value

A data frame with one row per family, year and source. See `vignette("data-sources")` for the columns.

Examples

reg <- get_data_registry()
subset(reg, status == "served")
